title: Golden Asp
summary: The Golden Asp was large structure carved as a serpent and served as the entrance to King Solomon's mines. The Golden Asp was guarded by the three Titan colossi: Ashtoreth, Chemosh, and Milcom. Pressing the eye of the serpent would open the doors but would also wake the colossi.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
King Solomon left all his treasure inside the Mines and his love, the Queen of Sheba left three collosi to guard the structure. [The Golden Asp] At some point in history, Cherit visited the location. [The Golden Asp]

The Huntik team found a sketch of the serpent in Eathon Lambert's journal. With help from Otto, they ventured into the Ethiopian desert and, thanks to Cherit's familiarity with the location found the burial marker, pointing them towards the Golden Asp. However, when Cherit touched the eye of the serpent, the three colossi awoke and began to attack them. [The Golden Asp] Working with Montehue and Tersly, the Huntik team were able to defeat the three colossi and enter the Mines. [To Be Together]
